meta.title: Siaya Source Library
meta.note: One record per document: the 27 sources in the research programme register (section 2, IDs kept), the documents those pages link to directly, and every document the site already cites. A record is "downloaded" only when the bytes were saved and checked to be a valid file of the stated type; sha256 and bytes are then recorded. "discovered" means the page or record exists but the document itself was not saved (a landing page, a collection, or a live service). "inaccessible" means the address failed (not found, maintenance, certificate error). "blocked" means a bot check stopped the request. Where the publisher states no licence, the record says "not stated: link and cite only" and redistribution_allowed is false. Files are not republished by Takwimu. Reuse model (sweep D2, owner decision 21 Nov 2026): data_reuse says what may be done with the figures ("figures may be reused with citation", "link and cite only" or "permission required"); document_redistribution says whether the document itself may be republished. redistribution_allowed is kept equal to document_redistribution for older readers. Bulk downloads on the site are offered only for datasets whose sources allow figure reuse (scripts/validate-data.js). Research sweep of 27 Nov 2026: the primary and official sources it found are added (county planning and budget papers held by the KIPPRA repository, Auditor-General and Senate reports from the Parliament library, the PBO, KNBS, CRA and others), each with its retrieval status; academic papers and media claims stay in docs/research/sweep-2026-11-27.
meta.method: Each address fetched with curl -sL (60-second timeout) through the environment's HTTPS proxy on 21 Nov 2026; failures retried once or twice and the result of each attempt noted. PDFs were checked for the %PDF- header and %%EOF trailer; SHA-256 computed locally. Records from data/source-manifest.json keep the hash recorded when the figures were read; small files were downloaded again and compared.
